fusions.name: Marsh Spring
fusions.desc: Springs up out of a crouch and butts the target for 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bog Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 8 damage, rising to 1.6 times that from the full 6 tiles. It has a 40% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Landing Crouch
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Back to the Cliff
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, your physical damage rises by 40% for 8 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
